name: Chair Sit-to-Stand
instructions: Place a sturdy chair against a wall so it cannot slide. Sit near the front edge with your feet flat on the floor, about hip-width apart.
Lean forward slightly and press through your feet to stand up.
Lower yourself back onto the chair slowly and under control.
Repeat for the planned number of repetitions.

name: Wall Angel
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall, feet a small step away from it.
Bring your arms up to the sides with elbows bent, keeping your upper arms, elbows and the backs of your hands against the wall as far as feels comfortable.
Slide your arms slowly up the wall, then back down.
Move only within a range that feels comfortable, and repeat for the planned number of repetitions.

name: Seated Marching
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat on the floor, holding the sides of the seat if you like.
Lift one knee a little way off the floor, then lower the foot back down.
Repeat with the other leg, alternating sides in a steady rhythm.
Continue for the planned number of repetitions.
